## Description

Assesses candidate Green Field sites against mandatory infrastructure minimums (wastewater, power, industrial water, logistics access) per `checklists/site-selection-checklist.yaml` — wastewater checked before power, since its absence blocks expansion outright regardless of power availability. Use when: "site infrastructure", "wastewater capacity", "power supply capacity", "logistics access assessment", "site selection".
